question: Why must breath-control be performed before engaging the remembered triad of principles?
premises: It is performed before the triad.
The triad is remembered or prescribed.
inference: Breath-control is a preparatory act that should precede application of the remembered triad.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of tattva+trayaṃ smṛtam may be appositional or part of a broader instruction.
plain_english: Then one should perform breath-control; this triad of principles is remembered.
